title: Billing Rules for the Continuum Backup & Recovery Monthly Plan Fee
content:
The monthly fee of a Continuum Backup & Recovery plan is invoiced in advance on the first day of each service month. It equals the contracted server rate multiplied by billed servers, plus the contracted workstation rate multiplied by protected workstations, plus the contracted Microsoft 365 user rate multiplied by protected Microsoft 365 users, counted at the end of the previous month, plus the storage overage, the total rounded half up to the cent.

## Quantities in the fee

**Billed servers.** The greater of (a) the protected servers, counted at the end of the month before the service month, and (b) the contracted servers multiplied by the tier's minimum server commitment percentage and divided by 100, rounded up to a whole server.

**Protected workstations and protected Microsoft 365 users.** The number of each class protected under the plan, counted at the end of the month before the service month.

**Storage allowance.** The tier's protected storage included per billed server, multiplied by billed servers, pooled across the plan: the allowance is one figure for the whole plan, not a separate allowance for each server.

**Protected server storage.** The total protected server storage, in TB, reported by the backup console across all protected servers of the plan, as at the true-up snapshot taken on the last day of the month before the service month.

**Storage overage.** The protected server storage above the storage allowance, rounded up to the tier's overage rounding increment, multiplied by the tier's overage rate per TB. Where protected server storage does not exceed the allowance, there is no storage above it to bill.

The contracted rates are the rates recorded on the plan.

## Which months are invoiced

| Service month | Monthly fee invoiced? |
|---|---|
| The service month after activation | Yes — this is the first fee |
| A month during which the plan is suspended | Yes — the fee continues during suspension |
| A month beginning after the cancellation effective date | No |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures only)

Inputs, all hypothetical: contracted rates of 100.00 USD per server, 9.45 USD per workstation and 2.85 USD per Microsoft 365 user; 5 contracted servers on a tier with a 90 percent minimum server commitment, 1 TB included per billed server, a 0.25 TB overage increment and an overage rate of 20.00 USD per TB. At the end of the previous month the plan protected 3 servers, 20 workstations and 40 Microsoft 365 users, and the true-up snapshot showed 6.32 TB of protected server storage.

| Quantity | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Commitment floor | 5 contracted servers multiplied by 90, divided by 100, is 4.5, rounded up | 5 |
| Billed servers | The greater of 3 protected servers and 5 | 5 |
| Server charge | 100.00 USD multiplied by 5 | 500.00 USD |
| Workstation charge | 9.45 USD multiplied by 20 | 189.00 USD |
| Microsoft 365 user charge | 2.85 USD multiplied by 40 | 114.00 USD |
| Storage allowance | 1 TB multiplied by 5 billed servers, pooled | 5 TB |
| Storage above the allowance | 6.32 TB less 5 TB is 1.32 TB, rounded up to the 0.25 TB increment | 1.5 TB |
| Storage overage | 1.5 TB multiplied by 20.00 USD | 30.00 USD |
| Monthly fee | 500.00 plus 189.00 plus 114.00 plus 30.00, rounded half up to the cent | 833.00 USD |

Had the plan protected 6 servers at the end of the previous month, billed servers would be 6 (the greater of 6 and 5), and the storage allowance would be 6 TB.
